act.name: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
act.source_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
act.description: Child-protection law covering sexual offences, mandatory reporting, child-friendly procedure and Special Courts.

sections.title: Reporting of offences.
sections.text: Section 19 requires information about an offence under the Act to be reported to the appropriate authority.
sections.plain_language_summary: Anyone who apprehends or knows of a POCSO offence must report it as the section requires.

sections.title: Recording of statement of a child.
sections.text: Section 24 provides child-friendly safeguards for recording a child's statement.
sections.plain_language_summary: A child's statement must be recorded using the child-sensitive safeguards specified by the Act.

sections.title: Procedure and powers of Special Court.
sections.text: Section 33 provides the procedure and powers of the Special Court for offences under the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: Sets child-protective procedures that a POCSO Special Court must follow.

sections.title: Right of child to take assistance of legal practitioner.
sections.text: Section 40 recognizes a child's right to assistance from a legal practitioner in proceedings under the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: A child and family may take assistance from a lawyer during POCSO proceedings.
